capabilities: Lock and unlock notes with a vault-wide or per-note password
Encrypt note bodies in place inside a fenced locker block while keeping .md storage
Auto-lock notes on navigation, inactivity timeout, and quit
Show a status-bar count of unlocked notes and lock all at once
Re-secure notes left exposed after a crash using a recovery ledger
extras: README warns there is no password recovery, plaintext is written to disk while a note is unlocked, and the protection targets casual at-rest access rather than a determined attacker with live vault access. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; pre-release builds are available via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian stores notes as unencrypted text on disk, so sensitive note bodies are readable by anyone with access to the vault files or a synced copy.

relations.evidence: Track pre-release builds by adding the repo danzar/Obsidian-Locker in the BRAT plugin.

summary: Note encryption plugin that locks note contents at rest with AES-GCM-256 while keeping titles visible and files as plain .md.
